title: US 421 over South Fork Wildcat Creek
source_note: INDOT 2020 rehabilitation plans,30 PDF pages. Permanent proposed deck/endspans plus retained open-top steel truss. Source fabrication gaps explicitly labeled.

coordinate_system.native: X longitudinal increasing station; Y transverse; Z elevation above778 ft

assumptions: Use permanent rehabilitated configuration, including retained existing truss. Temporary jacks, falsework and construction supports are excluded.
Cover p1 end spans 30 ft 8.5 in conflict with repeated 31 ft 8.5 in on pp6,7,20,21. Model follows the detailed framing and beam sheets (31 ft 8.5 in bearing-to-bearing; 32 ft 8.5 in beam length).
Native X origin is Abutment 1 station 42+54.00, Z datum elevation 778 ft. Deck follows the 600 ft vertical curve and 2 percent crown crossfall on pp6/7.
Upper-node heights are scaled from p16 (12.5,15,16,16.5,16.5,16,15,12.5 ft above lower chord); these are not dimensioned fabrication elevations.
Open-top truss topology follows pp7/16/18: outward rakers and lower lateral bracing; no unsupported overhead portal/top bracing is added.

Archived INDOT standard 1532 dated May 26,1939/revised November 12,1940 is referenced on p16 but absent. Existing chord channel sizes, typical gusset outlines, lacing pitch, bolts/rivets and stringer sections are explicit reconstructions.

FB1 36WF150, selected vertical 10WF33 and repaired diagonal 10WF37 are documented on pp18/19. Their nominal simplified profiles are repeated where other member designations are unavailable; historical fillets and exact weights are not modeled.

New end-gusset outline, thickness and handhole, new endpost cover plate and diagonal repair plate follow pp17-19. Gusset hole positions are transcribed from the diagram and require field verification, as the plans state.
Retained pier/abutment stems and footing elevations are scaled envelopes; hidden pile types, depths and reinforcement are not available and are omitted.

Bridge rails on new end spans follow the p27 FC profile. Referenced TFC, RCBA and Type7B standards are absent; approach slab thickness, transition profile and abutment-pad envelopes are marked assumptions.

This is a drawing-derived visual exterior reconstruction, not an as-built survey, connection design, fabrication model or structural analysis. No internal reinforcement or prestressing tendons are included.

Ten dimensioned SQ inlet stations, slotted grates, hollow6 in pipes, four pier collection downpipes/45-degree offsets and clamps; casting walls and fitted paths inferred.
